authority: Independent model/engineering audit of source-bound host checklists; not wet-lab expert gold or scientific validation.
scope: Read-only source/checklist audit. No candidate or reviewer artifact from the clean native extraction run was inspected for this audit. Earlier development exposure is not erased.

reviewed_scope_issues.initial_issue: A failure indicator implied that complete Supplementary Table1 sequences were registered.
reviewed_scope_issues.source_context: Primary JATS p00021 points to Table1, while JATS p00022 and HTML p00170 contain only the Table1 label.
reviewed_scope_issues.final_assessment: Resolved before candidate evaluation: final text forbids inventing sequences from labels and permits scoped unavailable-evidence gaps. No assertion that the published table does not exist.

reviewed_scope_issues.initial_issue: Primary-only ordering could penalize an honest qualification about droplet amplification/separation timing.
reviewed_scope_issues.source_context: Primary p00044 states amplification then0.6x size selection; registered supplement p00019 says PHO separation prior to amplification. The wording does not establish identical stage meanings.
reviewed_scope_issues.final_assessment: Resolved: final checklist includes the supplement witness, allows qualified coarse handoffs, and does not force either a single established order or an irreconcilable/blocking contradiction.

reviewed_scope_issues.initial_issue: Exact1:9 library ratio, platform and read cycles were combined with required joint-library architecture.
reviewed_scope_issues.source_context: Primary p00046 reports these settings; their omission alone does not establish a missing pooled-library interface.
reviewed_scope_issues.final_assessment: Resolved in preserved revision2: library identities/pooling/readout remain required; exact settings must be accurate if asserted, while their absence alone is assessed as detail omission.

evaluation_guidance: Assess source-defined preparation, encoding/copying, fraction retention, inter-operation handoffs, amplification, sequencing and decoding; do not require prescribed record names, node counts, Module boundaries or one decomposition.

Distinguish a required qualification from a mandatory optional procedure. scSTAMP SC-H06 must not force imaging or fluorophore nodes; SC-H17 is conditional on claiming that decoder, and SC-H19 is supporting characterization.

DBiT SOURCE15 is conditional on exact preprocessing claims; SOURCE18 governs represented imaging/validation rather than requiring characterization branches. SOURCE13 execution settings are not independent architecture blockers.
Method conditions and source-specific experimental demonstrations constrain positive claims without making every experiment part of the main production route.

Unavailable source details, source wording tension and delegated recipe internals require qualified scoped treatment; present-but-unextracted consequential facts are omissions, while quote matching alone does not establish entailment.
source_checked_content_assessment: No remaining concrete blocking checklist error identified in the inspected final versions. The finite source-backed checks fit the generic nine-dimensional host audit when their applicability qualifications are retained.
limits: This audit is not an exhaustive source completeness or biochemical feasibility judgment.
Both methods are exposed development cases; no family-generalization, novelty or contamination-resistance result follows.
Neither checklist enters the clean native extraction/review prompts. These remain host-only evaluation scaffolds, not reference graphs or source facts to inject during a run.
Any later changes require a reason, preserved earlier bytes and new pinned version; do not tune expectations after seeing a candidate.
